title: 把比较用到图表：水平、变化与分母
scope: 原创虚构数据的小练习，针对读图和比较措辞；不是官方 IELTS 题库、完整 Task 1 作文或分数预测。

lesson.heading: 先读水平，再说变化
lesson.text: 40%和50%是两个年份的水平。rose from 40% to 50% 交代起点与终点；rose by … 交代变化量。to 后的终点不能替换成变化量，by 后也不能直接填起点。

lesson.heading: 百分点与相对增幅的分母不同
lesson.text: 40%到50%相差10个百分点（50−40）；相对于原来的40%，增幅是25%（10÷40）。因此 rose by 10 percentage points 与 rose by 25% 可描述同一变化，但 rose by 10% 会说成44%。先确认谈的是差额还是相对变化。

lesson.heading: 同一年比较不是一段增长
lesson.text: 2024年tram占60%、bus占30%，tram share 是 bus share 的两倍，也比bus share高30个百分点或100%。这里没有两个年份，不能据此写 rose from 30% to 60%。占比来自同一人群才可直接比较；没有样本人数时，不把跨年的占比变化写成绝对人数增加。

lesson.heading: 比较结构服务于读图结论
lesson.text: 可以用 twice as high as 比占比，twice as many commuters … as … 比同一人群中的人数关系，也可以用 compared with / whereas 并列两个水平。没有要求堆砌复杂句；表格不说明票价、原因或未来趋势，就不添加这些结论。

contrasts.a: The bus share rose from 40% to 50%.
contrasts.b: The bus share rose by 10 percentage points.
contrasts.why: 前句报起点与终点，后句报百分点差，含义一致；by 40% 会改变数值关系。

contrasts.a: The tram share was twice the bus share.
contrasts.b: The tram share was 30% higher than the bus share.
contrasts.why: 60÷30=2，前句正确。后句会得到30%×1.3=39%，与60%不符；可改为30 percentage points higher或100% higher。

exercises.prompt: 选择同时准确交代百分点变化与相对于2016年的增幅的一句。
options: The bus share rose by 10%, a 25-percentage-point increase.
The bus share rose by 10 percentage points, a 25% increase relative to 2016.
The bus share rose to 10 percentage points, a 25% increase relative to 2016.
The bus share rose by 25 percentage points, a 10% increase relative to 2016.
exercises.answer: The bus share rose by 10 percentage points, a 25% increase relative to 2016.
exercises.explanation: 百分点差是50−40=10；相对增幅的基数是2016年的40，所以10÷40=25%。10%与10个百分点不是同一单位。
hints: 先做50−40，得到的是百分点差。
相对增幅还要除以起始水平40%，不是除以终点50%。

nearErrors.value: The bus share rose by 10%, a 25-percentage-point increase.
nearErrors.feedback: 10%与25个百分点都不符合表格：两种变化量的分母和单位写反了。

nearErrors.value: The bus share rose to 10 percentage points, a 25% increase relative to 2016.
nearErrors.feedback: to要交代终点水平50%；10个百分点是变化量，应用by。

nearErrors.value: The bus share rose by 25 percentage points, a 10% increase relative to 2016.
nearErrors.feedback: 差是10个百分点，相对2016年的增幅是25%，这两个数值和单位不能对调。

exercises.prompt: The bus share rose by 40% to 50% between 2016 and 2024. 这句话要保留两个水平和两年时间，不计算相对增幅。只替换一个介词来准确表达表格。
exercises.answer: The bus share rose from 40% to 50% between 2016 and 2024.
exercises.explanation: from 40%是起点，to 50%是终点。原句by 40%表达相对增长40%，会得到56%，不是表格中的50%。本题只换介词，不改成另一种正确但不符合限定的重写。
hints: 保留40%和50%两个水平，想清楚哪一个是起点。
交代起点和终点用from … to …；by后面接变化量。

nearErrors.value: The bus share rose by 40% to 50% between 2016 and 2024.
nearErrors.feedback: by 40%是相对增加40%，与40%→50%的记录不符。只将by改为表示起点的from。

nearErrors.value: The bus share rose to 40% from 50% between 2016 and 2024.
nearErrors.feedback: 起点和终点倒置了；2016年是40%，2024年是50%。

nearErrors.value: The bus share rose from 50% to 40% between 2016 and 2024.
nearErrors.feedback: 数值方向被改成下降，与表格相反，而且rose与这条方向不一致。

exercises.prompt: 写一至两句英文，比较2024年tram与bus的占比。任选自然比较结构；须交代60%与30%或明确两倍、半数或30个百分点差的关系。不虚构时间变化、原因或人数。
exercises.answer: Trams accounted for 60% of commuters, twice the bus share of 30%.
accepted: At 60%, the tram share was twice the bus share, which was 30%.
The tram share was 60%, compared with 30% for buses.
Trams accounted for 60% of commuters, whereas buses accounted for 30%.
Sixty percent of commuters used trams, compared with thirty percent who used buses.
Sixty per cent of commuters used trams, compared with thirty per cent who used buses.
Twice as many commuters used trams as used buses.
Twice as many commuters used trams as buses.
The proportion of commuters using trams was twice that of commuters using buses.
The tram share was twice as high as the bus share.
Trams were used by 60% of commuters and buses by 30%.
60% of commuters used trams, while 30% used buses.
The tram share exceeded the bus share by 30 percentage points.
The tram share was 30 percentage points higher than the bus share.
Compared with the bus share, the tram share was 100% higher.
The share using buses was half the share using trams.
The tram share was double the bus share.
Trams had a 60% share, while buses had a 30% share.
In Lakeford in 2024, 60% of respondents mainly commuted by tram, compared with 30% by bus.
In Lakeford in 2024, the share commuting mainly by tram was twice that commuting mainly by bus.
In Lakeford in 2024, the shares for trams and buses were 60% and 30%, respectively.
In Lakeford in 2024, trams accounted for 60%, whereas buses accounted for 30%.
In Lakeford in 2024, the tram share was 100% higher than the bus share, at 60% compared with 30%.
In Lakeford in 2024, the tram share was 30 percentage points higher than the bus share.
exercises.explanation: 这是同一年同一人群的比较：60÷30=2，60−30=30个百分点。多种比较结构都可以；这一小组自动核对仅覆盖本站有限参考，其他表达可保留并人工检查。不能用这个横截面虚构一段增长或原因。
hints: 先判断比较的是两个年份，还是同一年的两种方式。
从表格可以算60÷30或60−30；选择比值或百分点差，再选自己的比较结构。

nearErrors.value: The tram share was 30% higher than the bus share.
nearErrors.feedback: 30% higher意味着30%×1.3=39%，不是60%；这里是30个百分点高或100%高。

nearErrors.value: The bus share was twice the tram share.
nearErrors.feedback: 两倍关系反了：tram是60%，bus是30%；bus share是tram share的一半。

nearErrors.value: Trams accounted for 60% of commuters, three times the bus share of 30%.
nearErrors.feedback: 60÷30=2，不是3；数字正确但比值结论错误。

nearErrors.value: The tram share increased from 30% to 60%.
nearErrors.feedback: 表格是2024年的方式对比，没有过去tram占比30%的记录；不要虚构时间变化。

nearErrors.value: Trams were more popular because tickets were cheaper.
nearErrors.feedback: 表格没给票价或原因；这句也没有交代题目所需的数值或比值关系。

nearErrors.value: The tram share was 200% higher than the bus share.

independent.prompt: 阅读另一座城市的表格，写2—3句：先概括总体变化，再选一组数字说明。自行选择比较/变化结构，准确标注百分比或百分点。不从占比推断绝对人数或因果。
criteria: 先概括cars占比下降、bicycles和other占比上升；可以说cars仍是最大的单一类别。
再用一组数字支持比较，例如cars从60%降至40%，或bicycles上升10个百分点。
时间变化用from/to或by交代水平或差；横向比较说明比较对象与同一分母。
表格没有样本人数、原因或未来数据，保留这些未知。
Other是合计，不能推出其中每一种方式都增加；largest不等于超过50%的majority。
自行选择词句；这里只保存草稿和自查，准确性、连贯性、概览质量与自然度继续人工核对。
independent.reference: Overall, the car share fell, while the bicycle and other-mode shares increased. Cars still had the largest share in 2024, although their proportion dropped from 60% to 40%. The bicycle share rose by 10 percentage points to 30%.
independent.referenceNote: 这是对本站虚构表格的一种写法，不是唯一答案。先写自己的段落再对照；不自动给开放段落打分。

dataNote: 以下数据由本站虚构。各表比例的分母为该城市、该年份的受访通勤者，每人只选一种主要方式。各年样本人数未提供，也未声明为同一批人；Other 是其他方式的合计。
